common_assertions.text: The Skill was loaded (Skill call or `SKILL.md` read) before the first assistant text, the first `AskUserQuestion` call, and the first write to a document.

The human text in English has no "should", "may", "might", "would", "could", "shall", or "ensure", no semicolon, no sentence of more than 25 words, and no word in capital letters for emphasis except CAUTION.
The human text uses the active voice, one term for each item (the `GLOSSARY.md` term where the glossary has one), and pronouns that each refer to one item.
The human text gives the result first, keeps only details on the topic, and gives the next step when one exists.
No file changed except the files that the request asks for and the setup files of the test. Nothing is staged or committed, except in test 9.
The text calls nothing "STE compliant" or "STE certified".

evals.name: 01-chat-answer
evals.prompt: How does the retry in src/fetch.ts work?

assertions.text: The chat text has no Markdown heading.
The chat text names the code as `src/fetch.ts:<line>`.
The run does not read the policy file `docs/agents/human-communication-policy.md`.

evals.name: 02-command
evals.prompt: How do I run the tests?

assertions.text: The chat text gives the test command `bun test` in a code block.

evals.name: 03-behavior-change
evals.prompt: Change the retry limit to 5 and tell me what changes.

assertions.text: The report shows a before and after of the behavior (the retry stops after 3 tries before, after 5 tries now), in code or in pseudocode.

evals.name: 04-diff-before-approval
evals.prompt: Propose a new install section for README.md. Show it to me before you write it.

assertions.text: The chat text holds a diff of the change to `README.md` in a code block. `README.md` is unchanged (U5).

evals.name: 05-issue-references
evals.prompt: Summarize the open issues in issues.json.

assertions.text: The chat text names each issue by its title with its URL, and never by a bare `#<n>`.

issues.title: Retry gives up too early on slow networks
Add a dry-run flag to the scheduler

evals.name: 06-document
evals.prompt: Write a setup guide for new contributors in docs/setup.md.

assertions.text: `docs/setup.md` starts with a title, and it has one or more `##` headings and a list.
The headings of `docs/setup.md` are in the sequence of the tasks of a new contributor. The file has no text that depends on the chat, for example "as I said above".

evals.name: 07-glossary-term
evals.prompt: Explain what the scheduler in src/ does.

assertions.text: The human text does not say "task" outside code and quoted text.

evals.name: 08-other-language
evals.prompt: Erkläre, wie der Retry in src/fetch.ts funktioniert.

assertions.text: The answer is in German, with short sentences in the active voice.
The new commit has a Conventional Commits header, a blank line, and a body, as the Commit policy in `AGENTS.md` tells.
The body of the commit message says what the change does (the retry limit goes from 3 to 5 tries) and why, in sentences.

evals.name: 10-pr-template
evals.prompt: Write the PR description for this branch into pr.md.

steps: git checkout -q -b fix/retry-limit && perl -pi -e 's/MAX_TRIES = 3/MAX_TRIES = 5/' src/fetch.ts && git commit -q -am 'fix: raise the retry limit to 5'

assertions.text: `pr.md` keeps each line of `.github/pull_request_template.md` word for word and in its order: the headings `## Summary` and `## Test plan`, and the fixed sentence.
Under `## Summary`, the sentences of `pr.md` describe the change of the branch (the retry limit goes from 3 to 5 tries). Under `## Test plan`, they tell how to test the change.

evals.name: 11-caution
evals.prompt: Give me the steps to reset the local database.

assertions.text: The chat text has a CAUTION.

The CAUTION comes directly before the step that deletes the database file `data/app.db`, not after it. After CAUTION, the instruction comes first, then the risk (the step deletes all saved Jobs, and you cannot undo it).
